gate.title: Readiness gate and watch
gate.rules: Takes traffic after {{passes}} readiness passes in a row and {{stable}} running without a restart. The previous release drains for {{drain}}, then this one is watched for {{watch}}.
gate.pinned: Pinned as rollback target {{ref}}, so image cleanup will never remove it.
gate.empty: No gate steps recorded yet. They appear once the new container starts.
gate.unavailable: The gate timeline is not available for this deploy.

settings.title: Deploy safety
settings.description: A new release takes traffic only after its readiness probe passes several times in a row and it runs for a stable window without restarting or being OOM-killed. The previous release keeps serving in-flight requests while it drains. After cutover the release is watched, and a crashloop, OOM kill or 5xx spike rolls it back.
settings.inheritHint: Leave a field empty to use the platform default shown in it.
settings.unavailable: Deploy safety settings could not be loaded.

success_threshold.label: Readiness passes in a row
success_threshold.hint: Consecutive readiness probe passes before traffic moves.

stable_window.label: Stable window
stable_window.hint: How long the new container must run with no restart or OOM kill, e.g. 10s.

drain_timeout.label: Drain timeout
drain_timeout.hint: How long the previous release keeps serving after cutover, e.g. 15s.

watch_window.label: Watch window
watch_window.hint: How long a new release is watched after cutover, e.g. 10m.

watch_latency_ratio.label: p95 latency multiple that counts as a regression
watch_latency_ratio.hint: Compared with the previous release. 0 turns the latency check off.

watch_max_restarts.label: Restarts that trip the watch
watch_max_restarts.hint: Container restarts inside the watch window that count as a crashloop.

watch_error_rate.label: 5xx share that trips the watch (%)
watch_error_rate.hint: Share of requests answered with 5xx inside the watch window.

watch_min_requests.label: Requests before the 5xx share counts
watch_min_requests.hint: A handful of requests is not enough to judge a release.

autoRollback.label: Roll back automatically when the watch trips

toast.error: Could not save deploy safety settings.

autoRollback.title: Auto rollback
autoRollback.description: After a release takes traffic it is watched for a window. A crashloop, OOM kill or a 5xx spike is a hard signal. A p95 latency regression against the previous release is a soft signal and never rolls back unless you opt in.
autoRollback.inheritHint: Leave a field empty to use the platform default shown in it.

soft.label: Let a latency regression roll back too
soft.hint: Only applies in auto mode. Otherwise a latency regression only sends an alert.

toast.error: Could not save auto rollback settings.

watch.stopped: The watch was stopped before the window ended.
watch.off: Post-deploy watch is off for this app.
watch.rollbackDescription: Traffic moves back to the retained previous release.
watch.rollbackConsequence: The previous release {{ref}} is redeployed through the same readiness gate.
watch.noTarget: No retained earlier release to roll back to yet.

targets.title: Pinned rollback targets
targets.empty: No pinned releases yet. A release is pinned when it takes traffic.

publishLock.bannerBody_one: {{by}} locked it. The live release stays pinned and {{count}} build is held.
publishLock.bannerBody_other: {{by}} locked it. The live release stays pinned and {{count}} builds are held.
publishLock.publishedToast: Published. The held build is going live.
publishLock.rollbackLockHint: Redeploy this release and hold every later build
publishLock.error: Could not change the publish lock.
